records.rationale: All five items on the Collision evidence list are on file: the intake record, a description of the loss, the vehicle identification, two damage photos (IMG_0071.jpg, IMG_0072.jpg) and repair estimate GC-24418 (repair_estimate.pdf). The amount on the intake record ($10,100.00) does not match the estimate's net total ($2,825.07), and nothing on file explains the difference; the adjuster notes (adjuster_notes.md) put the claim on hold for this reason. The adjuster notes describe a backing incident, while the estimate describes hitting a bollard while pulling forward; the front-left damage in the photos fits the estimate's account. The date of loss and the policy period are blank and the policy status is unknown, so coverage on the day of the loss cannot be confirmed from the file. The ClaimsPro disposition 'Paid in Full' conflicts with a status history that ends at Assigned. The claim needs the following before a person can decide it: the date of loss, coverage confirmation, documents supporting the $10,100 figure, an explanation of the recorded disposition, and confirmation that the estimate belongs to this claim.
